question: A book shop maintains the inventory of books that are being sold at the shop. The list includes details such as author, title, price, publisher and stock position. Whenever a customer wants a book, the sales person inputs the title and author to the system. If it is not available, "Not found" message is displayed. If it is available, then the system displays the book details and requests for the number of copies required. If the requested copies are available, the total cost of the requested copies is displayed; otherwise "Required copies not in stock" is displayed. Design a system using a class called books with suitable member functions and constructors. Use new operator in constructors to allocate memory space required.
